players.empty: No players connected to the server
players.no_matches_description: Try searching with a different username.

players.empty_description: Connect to the server with the game, or use Simulate Telemetry to inspect active player sessions.

edit_server.java_path_hint: Overrides the global Java executable path. Leave blank to use system default.
edit_server.running_warning: Turn the server off to apply port or JVM changes.
edit_server.bridge_description: Deploy the native high-frequency bridge (Paper plugin or Fabric mod) to enable silent real-time TPS, MSPT, loaded chunks, and per-player health & coordinates directly over WebSocket without console polling.
edit_server.bridge_installed_restart: Telemetry Bridge installed. Restart the server to activate it.
edit_server.bridge_installed_ready: Telemetry Bridge is installed and ready. It will activate the next time the server starts.
edit_server.bridge_unsupported: There is no Telemetry Bridge for this server loader yet.
edit_server.presets_hint: Recommended flag sets for this game. Applying one merges its flags into the field below.

aikar.label: Aikar's flags
aikar.desc: Tuned G1GC set for Paper-family servers with 4 GB or more. Best for Paper, Purpur and Spigot.

g1-basic.label: G1GC basic
g1-basic.desc: Light, safe G1 tuning for modded and vanilla servers (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Vanilla).

zgc.label: Generational ZGC
zgc.desc: Very low pause times on large heaps. Needs Java 21 or newer.

java23-unsafe.label: Silence Unsafe warning
java23-unsafe.desc: Hides the sun.misc.Unsafe deprecation warning printed by JOML on Java 23+. Do not use on older Java: the server will not start.

edit_server.bridge_remove_offline: Stop the server to remove the bridge.
edit_server.ram_hint: Memory the server may use. Leave room for your system and other apps.
edit_server.autostart_hint: Starts this server each time Hosty opens.
edit_server.force_save_hint: Sends the game's save command first so no progress is lost.
edit_server.auto_restart_hint: If the server closes unexpectedly, Hosty starts it again (up to 5 attempts).
edit_server.scheduled_restart_hint: Restarts the server every N hours while it runs, warning players first. 0 turns it off.
edit_server.backups_kept_hint: Older backups are deleted automatically when a new one exceeds this number.

onboarding.welcome_desc: You do not have any game servers configured yet. Hosty lets you create dedicated servers from scratch or import existing folders.

updater.update_available_desc: Hosty v{{version}} is ready to install.

startup.title: Starting Hosty

sidebar.open_folder_failed: Could not open the server folder
sidebar.remove_imported_desc: "{{name}}" will disappear from Hosty. Its folder and files are NOT deleted, so you can import it again later.
sidebar.delete_created_desc: "{{name}}" and all of its files (worlds, mods, configs) will be permanently deleted from disk.

server_icon.hint_game: Also used as the server icon inside {{game}} ({{file}}). It must be a {{size}}×{{size}} PNG: any image is cropped and resized automatically.
server_icon.hint_app: Only shown inside Hosty: {{game}} has no server icon of its own. Any image works; it is cropped to a square automatically.

server_header.kill_confirm_desc: The process is terminated immediately. Unsaved world progress may be lost.

wizard.no_games_desc: Turn a game on in Game packs (sidebar) to create a server for it.

step_desc.origin: Create a new server or import one you already have.
step_desc.game: Choose the game this server will run.
step_desc.setup: Configure the server software for this game.
step_desc.customize: Name your server, set resources and make it yours.

wizard.origin_create_desc: Pick a game, download the server files automatically and customize everything.
wizard.origin_import_desc: Add a server folder that is already on this PC. The game and loader are detected for you.
wizard.import_unknown: This folder is not a valid server for any supported game, so it cannot be imported.
wizard.setup_nothing: No extra setup is needed for {{game}}.
wizard.use_own_jar: Use my own server file (its type is detected automatically)
wizard.java_required_desc: This version needs Java {{required}} or newer.
wizard.ram_system: This PC has {{total}} GB of RAM
wizard.port_taken_instance: Another server of yours already uses this port.
wizard.port_in_use: This port is in use by another program on this PC.
wizard.warn_icon: The server was created, but the icon could not be saved.
wizard.warn_properties: The server was created, but game mode and difficulty could not be applied.
wizard.done_desc: Your server was created. You can start it now or open its panel to keep configuring.
wizard.import_wrong_game: This folder looks like a "{{detected}}" server, not "{{selected}}". Go back and choose the right game.

wizard.bridge_later: You can also install or check it later from Edit server > Telemetry Bridge.
wizard.warn_bridge: The server was created, but the Telemetry Bridge could not be installed. You can retry from Edit server.

config.no_files: This game has no editable configuration files.
config.file_missing: {{file}} does not exist yet. Start the server once so the game creates it.

packs.title: Game packs
packs.description: Games are add-ons. Browse the signed catalog or install a pack from a folder; disable or remove the ones you do not use.
packs.trust_warning: This pack includes code (driver.js) that would run with the same permissions as Hosty. Only trust packs from authors you know.
packs.install_placeholder: Path to a game pack folder (contains hosty-game.json)
packs.verified_hint: Published in the signed Hosty catalog. Every file was checked against its signature before installing.
packs.catalog_hint: Packs from the signed Hosty catalog. Each file is verified before it is installed.
packs.catalog_empty: The catalog has no packs yet.

mod_catalog.title: Find mods
mod_catalog.description: Search {{source}} and download straight into this server. Results are filtered by the server's loader and version.
mod_catalog.restart_required: Restart the server to load it.
mod_catalog.no_versions: No versions match the current loader and game version.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Zip copies of the server data. Restoring replaces the current files.
backups.confirm_restore: Restore this backup? A safety copy of the current state is created first.
backups.stop_first: Stop the server to restore a backup.
backups.version_hint: Switch loader or version. A backup is created first.
backups.version_confirm: Update the server version? A backup is created first.

network.title: Network access
network.description: Addresses other players can use to join this server.
network.public_unknown: Could not detect your public IP (offline?).
network.forwarding_hint: Forward port {{port}} (TCP and UDP) on your router to this computer, and allow it in the firewall.
network.firewall_confirm: Create inbound firewall rules for port {{port}}? Needs administrator rights.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, colours, density and motion of the app.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: How the server console looks and behaves.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Defaults for new servers and where Hosty keeps its files.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Back up, restore or reset your preferences.

language.label: Language
language.description: Language of the interface. Community translations appear here once installed.

launch_at_login.label: Start Hosty with the system
launch_at_login.description: Open Hosty automatically when you sign in to your computer.
launch_at_login.failed: Could not change the startup setting

check_updates.label: Check for updates on launch
check_updates.description: Look for a new Hosty version a few seconds after it opens.

confirm_stop.label: Confirm before stopping with players online
confirm_stop.description: Ask before stopping or restarting a server that has connected players.

mode.label: Colour mode
mode.description: System follows your operating system and switches live.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Colour palette of the whole app. Each theme has a light and a dark version.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Used for selections, progress bars and highlights.

tokens.label: Advanced colours
tokens.description: Override individual colours of the theme. Changes apply to the mode you are using now.
tokens.contrast_warning: Low contrast: {{tokens}} may be hard to read on the surface colour.

density.label: Density
density.description: Compact reduces the spacing around pages and console lines.

ui_scale.label: Interface size
ui_scale.description: Zoom the whole interface in or out.

motion.label: Animations
motion.description: System follows the reduced motion setting of your operating system.

theme_transfer.label: Share theme
theme_transfer.description: Export the theme, accent and custom colours to share them, or import one.
theme_transfer.import_description: Paste an exported Hosty theme or load its file. Only colours change.

preview.label: Preview
preview.description: Every change below shows here and in the server console.

theme.label: Terminal theme
theme.description: Colours of the console, independent from the app theme.

font.label: Font
font.description: Fonts that are not installed fall back to Geist Mono.

wrap.label: Wrap long lines
wrap.description: When off, long lines scroll horizontally.

timestamps.label: Show timestamps
timestamps.description: Show the time at the start of each log line.

highlight_levels.label: Highlight log levels
highlight_levels.description: Colour warnings, errors and the commands you send.

rules.label: Highlight rules
rules.description: Colour lines that match a pattern (regular expression). The first matching rule wins.
rules.invalid: Invalid pattern: it is ignored until fixed.

autoscroll.label: Auto-scroll
autoscroll.description: When the console follows new output.

buffer.label: Lines kept
buffer.description: How many lines the console keeps in memory. More lines use more memory.

history.label: Command history
history.description: Commands remembered per server (Up and Down arrows). 0 turns it off.

clear_on_restart.label: Clear on start
clear_on_restart.description: Empty the console every time the server starts.

quick_commands.label: Quick commands
quick_commands.description: Buttons above the console. Hide the ones from the game or add your own.

servers.unavailable: Available when the daemon is connected.

default_memory.label: Default memory
default_memory.description: Memory for new servers. When off, each game uses its own default.

default_java.label: Default Java
default_java.description: Java executable for new servers. Empty uses the detected Java.

default_autostart.label: Start new servers with Hosty
default_autostart.description: New servers start automatically when Hosty opens.

folders.label: Folders
folders.description: Where Hosty keeps servers, game packs and translations.
folders.hint: These locations come from the environment (MC_NEXUS_*); changing them needs a restart.

transfer.label: Preferences
transfer.description: Export every preference as JSON, import a saved file or restore the defaults.
transfer.import_description: Paste exported Hosty preferences or load the file. Your current preferences are replaced.
transfer.reset_description: Theme, terminal and general preferences go back to their defaults. Servers are not affected.

daemon.label: Daemon
daemon.description: Address of the background service that runs your servers.

clear_history.label: Command history
clear_history.description: Forget the console commands remembered for every server.

mock.label: Simulated telemetry
mock.description: Development only: fills the panel with fake players and metrics.
mock.disabled: Mock data is disabled in the daemon.

transfer.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard
transfer.invalid: This is not a valid Hosty export.
